template.p: The electronic refurbishment industry operates in a unique space within the circular economy, requiring dynamic inventory tracking, complex variant handling, and stringent tax compliance. Standard retail software often falls short when dealing with second-hand goods, where every incoming device has a distinct history, condition, and acquisition cost. Odoo bridges this gap by providing an all-in-one ecosystem explicitly designed to manage the volatile lifecycle of refurbished electronics.

By integrating procurement, technical grading, multi-channel sales, and specialized accounting into a single platform, Odoo eliminates the need for fragmented third-party tools and messy spreadsheets. Your business can seamlessly track a device from the moment it is purchased from a consumer or enterprise, through the technician's test bench, right up to the final customer invoice.

Empowering your business with Odoo means securing your profit margins through absolute traceability. It transforms operational headaches, like the VAT margin scheme and serial number management, into automated, background processes, freeing your team to focus on scaling your catalog and delivering premium quality tech to your customers.
Here is a quick summary of the core applications utilized in this industry:

li.p: Purchase: Procure incoming second-hand electronics, manage supplier orders, and accurately record the initial condition or categorization of your newly acquired inventory.
Inventory: Trace serial numbers and utilize conversion tools to transform generic or ungraded items into market-ready, condition-graded stock.
Sales / eCommerce: Showcase available graded inventory, prevent overselling out-of-stock devices, and dynamically adjust pricing based on specific product condition attributes.
Accounting: Manage tax compliance natively by tracking purchase and sales data to automate and calculate the VAT margin scheme for second-hand goods.

template.p: Procurement is the starting point of your circular economy. Utilizing the Purchase application allows you to seamlessly acquire incoming electronics, whether you are dealing with bulk lots of generic smartphones or highly specific models, setting a clear financial baseline for every device.

li.p: Leverage the Purchase app to buy standard generic products to convert later (e.g., "Smartphone") or specific ones (e.g., "Odoo Phone 19").
Capture the condition of the product directly on the purchase order, rather than just buying "to qualify" items to adjust your offer, leveraging the variant costs.

template.p: Turning mystery boxes into valuable assets requires strict traceability. Our technical conversion module empowers your team to seamlessly grade and convert products, establishing the exact condition, value, and identity of every device before it hits the shelves.

li.p: Utilize the seamless product conversions directly from the inventory replenishment screens.
Convert generic devices into their exact references once known, or transition the status of a device from "to qualify" to market-ready grades like "good" or "premium".

div.class: o_editor_banner user-select-none o-contenteditable-false lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-success pb-0 pt-3 ps-3 pe-3

div.p: Trigger product conversions on any stock move, allowing technicians to instantly swap a device's identity as soon as it passes the testing bench.

template.p: Monetizing your graded inventory is effortless when your sales channels communicate directly with the warehouse. Both the Sales and eCommerce applications dynamically adapt to your stock levels in real-time, ensuring customers only buy exactly what is physically available and ready to ship.

li.p: Use the Sales app or eCommerce storefront to list your fully qualified and graded devices.
Keep your catalog clean by deactivating "to qualify" variants for sale, while ensuring upgraded condition attributes automatically apply extra costs to the final retail price.
Rely on Sales Order stock capturing to immediately verify if a product is in stock, preventing the costly mistake of selling an unavailable device.

div.class: o_editor_banner user-select-none o-contenteditable-false lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-info pb-0 pt-3 ps-3 pe-3

div.p: Enforce strict tracking during the Delivery phase by capturing the exact serial number of the sold product, maintaining perfect stock order and permanently logging which customer owns which specific device.

template.p: Staying compliant with tax laws is non-negotiable for refurbishers. The Accounting module provides a streamlined way to isolate product margins across specific periods, allowing for quick, accurate, and fully compliant VAT adjustments tailored specifically for second-hand goods.

li.p: Use the Accounting app to calculate your product margin over a selected period, filtering specifically for products submitted to the VAT margin scheme (excluding brand-new items).
Ensure your reporting is completely accurate, as the total margin calculation automatically accounts for both the purchase and sales values during that specific period.
Execute your periodic regularization by creating a specific Account Move (Journal Entry):
Add a first line that withdraws the total margin amount (as a negative value);
And a second line adding it back while applying the appropriate VAT tax.

div.class: o_editor_banner user-select-none o-contenteditable-false lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-success pb-0 pt-3 ps-3 pe-3

div.p: A dedicated tax for margin scheme is available for second hand product with no tax for your invoices to hide your margin and taxes while exposing paramount legal mentions.

div.class: o_editor_banner user-select-none o-contenteditable-false lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-warning pb-0 pt-3 ps-3 pe-3

div.p: Maintain strict bookkeeping discipline: invoices are paramount for accurate reporting in this process to validate both the acquisition cost and final sale price.

div.class: o_editor_banner user-select-none o-contenteditable-false lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-info pb-0 pt-3 ps-3 pe-3

div.p: If your calculated margin for the period is negative, rely on the system to postpone the adjustment to the next period, allowing you to account for both periods at once as permitted by most state tax laws.

div.p: You completed that demo use case! There are millions of other ways to adapt your Odoo setup to fit your business needs.
Discover more about Odoo by diving into our documentation and academy, and feel free to request a demo if you need help!

li.p: Enforce serial number scanning: Always require your warehouse and retail staff to scan serial numbers rather than selecting them manually. This drastically reduces human error and ensures the correct financial cost is pulled during the sale.

Audit your "To Qualify" stock: Set up a weekly routine to review products sitting in the "to qualify" state. Bottlenecks here tie up capital; moving them quickly through the conversion process keeps your cash flow healthy.

Standardize condition attributes: Keep your grading scale simple and easy to understand for the consumer (e.g., Fair, Good, Premium). Too many micro-grades will clutter your eCommerce store and confuse your testing technicians.

Reconcile often: Do not wait until the end of the fiscal year to run your VAT Margin regularization. Doing this monthly or quarterly ensures your tax liabilities are always transparent and manageable.
